value.rationale: The limit supplies a natural observable absent from dimension-only results: how conformal invariant mass redistributes among exponentially many retained branches when all branch lengths collapse. Its compactly supported tilted-exponential law changes from increasing to uniform to decreasing at a sharp cutoff and the full alphabet selects Exp(1). The exact e^(-gamma) correction to the minimal dimension-crossing alphabet provides a calibrated finite approximation scale. This is a structural measure-and-resolution transition in countable expanding dynamics, not just numerical evaluation of a single arbitrary constant.
